verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair axis for an email API platform, but the evidence pack never documents API tokens with limited scopes, permissions or domain restrictions. The only related item covers team-member access roles (mailersend-docs-11), which is user access management, not least-privilege API credentials for an agent, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
